source_text.ISS-0995: Q-976 / GH #2257: one structured attribution log line per authorization denial (method, route pattern, policy key, platform-scope boolean, keyed hashes of caller and tenant id); INV-4; sampled.

task.description: WF-03 Step 5: independently re-verify ISS-0995 acceptance criteria before issue close.
acceptance_criteria: One structured line per denial with method, route pattern, policy key, platform-scope flag
Caller/tenant only as keyed hashes; key derived from config secret; no literal, no new env var, no config diff
No raw identifiers, proven by test

result.summary: PASS. (1) lib/letflow/plugs/authorize.ex calls AuthzDenyLog.log_denial(conn, ctx, policy_key) as the first expression of the :Deny403 branch (single call site in lib/); lib/letflow/api/authz_deny_log.ex format_message/2 renders 'authz_deny method=.. route=.. policy=.. platform_scope=.. caller_platform_tenant=.. caller=.. tenant=..' plus identical logger metadata from one fields map. (2) caller/tenant are hash_id/3 = first 16 hex of HMAC-SHA256(subkey, 'user:'|'tenant:' <> id), subkey = HMAC-SHA256(Application.get_env(:letflow, :secrets_master_key), 'letflow/authz-deny-log/v1' <> <<1>>); no literal key, get_env not fetch_env! so no boot failure; `git diff origin/main --stat -- config lib/letflow/application.ex` is empty (no config/*.exs change, no new env var). (3) test/letflow/api/authz_deny_log_test.exs test (d) refutes raw user id, tenant id, slug, email, token, path/query/body values and key material in the line over four request shapes. (4) sampling by {policy, caller hash, tenant hash} slot in 4096-slot atomics, 60 s window with suppressed=n carry; tested in (h). (5) step-03c-security-reviewer.json result.status PASS (INV-1..10 addressed, issues empty); step-03d-reviewer PASS. Independent run (MIX_ENV=test MIX_TEST_PARTITION=47): test/letflow/api/authz_deny_log_test.exs test/letflow/plugs/authorize_test.exs test/letflow/login_discovery/notifier/smtp_test.exs test/letflow/login_discovery/notifier/smtp_smoke_test.exs test/letflow/api/platform_prefix_uniform_403_test.exs -> 'Result: 87 passed' (no failures); letflow_test47 dropped ('DROP DATABASE'). Handoff chain 01, 02, 02b, 03, 03c, 03d, 04, 04b all present, status COMPLETED/PASS; design validator round-1 FAIL handoff was overwritten in the working file by the round-2 PASS but is preserved in git (commit 454faf6b) and the round-2 summary discloses both BLOCKERs, so the chain is honest. Working tree clean before this handoff.
